method: Workload identity, direct modulo-byte checksum oracle, successful close and per-round records audited independently.
Native P50/P95 nearest-index order statistic recomputed from raw batches/rounds; throughput recomputed from summed workflow/release durations.
Every candidate compared only with its own paired baseline; no cross-candidate pooling or ranking of unpaired times.
Paired ratios then their median retained with first/last halves and AB/BA directions; no ratio of unpaired medians.
Derived close/preparation quantiles are separately labeled; Arena workflow excludes preparation and close; System workflow includes full preparation/release/close.
limitations: Descriptive synthetic observations only: CPU frequency, affinity, other activity and thread interleaving uncontrolled.
Mixed peak backing/provider vectors can differ despite matching API work and byte oracle; all differences retained.
prepared-single is a separate preallocated4096byte/reset profile, not evidence of general tiny or multiblock performance.
No new performance processes, compilation or device accesses are performed by this offline audit.
No formal confidence, Android performance, RSS, energy or product qualification.
